title: Inteligência de mercado
description:
*PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH*

Purpose/Role

The EIC is looking for two interns for the SupplyMap Database and the AssetMap Database. The Intern role is to support the Market Intelligence Managers in the delivery of the EIC product and to enhance and maintain the information that is stored in the database.

Key Aims and Objectives

  • To collate and enhance information on all companies in the relevant supply chains that work within the wider energy sector.
  • To ensure all data captured is of the highest quality and will allow for detailed analysis of the supply chain.
  • To assist the Energy Analysts- Operational Assets and Decommissioning in gathering new data and maintaining the existing data (locations, asset type, start-up years, operators, contractors and contacts) relating to producing energy assets tracked in the OPEX and ABEX data.
  • Ensure that all projects completed within the CAPEX database, EICDataStream are added to EICAssetMap.

Prime Responsibilities and Duties

  • Assist in the identification of all companies that provide capital goods and services to the wider energy sector in designated countries. Ensure that no duplicate companies exist in the listing.
  • Research, gather, maintain, and enhance information on each database. This will include gathering information from companies' house, company websites, phone calls and questionnaires.
  • As directed work closely with the Product Development team to test and deliver upgrades and enhancements to the databases and related products.
  • As requested, undertake demonstrations of EICSupplyMap/EICAssetMap.
  • Research, gather, maintain information on global locations of EIC members.
  • Input, maintain and improve the information in EICAssetMap. This will include identifying gaps in data, building depth to the data and ensuring that all projects across the energy industry are up to date.
  • Deal with member enquiries relating to EICAssetMap.
  • Attend where appropriate, and within the budget disciplines, seminars, conferences and workshops.
  • Work with the Consult Team when requested to provide information or assist with work on demand.
  • Assist in the delivery of OPEX and decommissioning related insight reports.
  • Provide support to the Membership Team and assist Energy Analysts in resolving any issues that may arise.

Key Internal Interfaces

  • Director, Market Intelligence
  • Market Intelligence Managers
  • Energy researchers and analysts
  • Membership Team
  • Consult Team
  • CEO

Key External Interfaces

  • EIC Members
  • Regional supply chains
  • Operators, Developers and EPC contractors
  • UKEF, DBT, SDI, OGA and other relevant partners in the process

Core Competencies

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written abilities
  • Team Work: As well as being highly self-motivated
  • Technical: A good grasp of IT issues and functional software packages
  • Planning and organising skills
  • Results oriented
  • Research: ability to use multiple sources of information

title: Coordenador de Logística de Pessoal
description:
Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Logística de Pessoal para atuar de forma estratégica e operacional, liderando os processos de Planejamento e Logística de Pessoal.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por estruturar, conduzir e evoluir os processos de logística de pessoal, assegurando continuidade operacional, atendimento aos cronogramas de embarque e desembarque, otimização de custos e conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios, trabalhistas e marítimos aplicáveis ao setor de Apoio Marítimo / Óleo & Gás.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar e coordenar a mobilização, desmobilização e substituição de profissionais, assegurando o atendimento às escalas, janelas operacionais e níveis exigidos de tripulação (CTS).
  • Gerir os cronogramas de embarque e desembarque, considerando restrições operacionais, disponibilidade de pessoal, atestados médicos, treinamentos mandatórios e certificações.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de interface e/ou fornecedores garantindo fluidez e alinhamento entre planejamento e execução.
  • Assegurar a conformidade regulatória e trabalhista, incluindo requisitos da DPC, MLC, acordos coletivos, normas internas e contratos aplicáveis.
  • Coordenar a logística de viagens (aéreo, terrestre e hospedagem), buscando otimização de custos, cumprimento de SLA de fornecedores e mitigação de riscos operacionais.
  • Monitorar e gerir os indicadores da área, acompanhando desempenho, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Antecipar e tratar situações críticas (ausências de última hora, restrições médicas, emergências operacionais), propondo soluções rápidas e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de Logística de Pessoal, promovendo padronização de processos, melhoria contínua e aderência aos procedimentos existentes.
  • Estruturar, revisar e garantir o cumprimento de procedimentos, fluxos e políticas de Logística de Pessoal.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências, relatórios e esclarecimentos relacionados à logística de pessoal.
  • Assegurar o correto lançamentos do eventos realizados (embarques, dobras, folgas, treinamentos) no sistema de gestão de tripulação.
  • Realizar a conferência e apuração dos lançamentos de caráter remuneratório, garantindo acuracidade das informações para input na folha de pagamento.
    Contribuir com iniciativas de digitalização, automação e melhoria de processos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Administração ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência com Planejamento e Logística de Pessoal no setor de apoio marítimo.
  • Conhecimento de Legislação Marítima.
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão de tripulação (preferencialmente BlueOpex).

Informações adicionais

Regime de trabalho Presencial

Benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Previdência Privada
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Total Pass
  • Programas de Assistência ao colaborador (Meu amigo Doutor e Use Vida)

Somos uma empresa brasileira de navegação (EBN) com operações em toda a costa brasileira e desde 2011 atuamos na prestação de serviços de apoio marítimo offshore à indústria de petróleo & gás. Nossas embarcações estão capacitadas a operar o transporte de cargas sólidas ou líquidas e transporte de pessoas.

Possuímos escritórios e bases operacionais nas regiões Sudeste (Rio de Janeiro) e Nordeste (Sergipe e Rio Grande do Norte) do Brasil e uma frota ampla para apoiar a demanda do setor em todo o país, sendo 14 FSVs, 6 Surfers e 2 PSVs.

Temos como propósito sermos reconhecidos como uma empresa de destaque na gestão de operações na navegação de apoio marítimo (offshore) e para viabilizar esse objetivo estratégico nosso direcionamento é a Excelência Operacional.

title: Architect
description:
Result of Service

The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Architect is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Architect will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
• Review of Program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural design.
• Analyze and review basic architectural projects, regarding aspects of dimensioning, urbanism, thermal comfort, ventilation, acoustics, energy efficiency, specifications of materials.
• Prepare reports and technical analysis on basic architectural projects.
• Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards.
• Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to architecture and compatibility of projects.
• Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects.
• Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project.
• Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team.
• Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Architect shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Architectural Preliminary Design Description: A consortium will design the architectural preliminary design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 80 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Basic Architectural Design Description: A consortium will design the basic architectural design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 160 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Use, Operation, and Maintenance Manual Description: A consortium will design the manual, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 240 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Compatibility inspection – Area 1 and 2 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Architect will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Architecture, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in basic projects for housing solutions in Brazil is required.
• Experience in architectural projects for social housing is required.
• Experience in urbanistic, and landscaping projects for informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using BIM are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. title: Sanitation Engineer
description:
Result of Service

The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review, and, when necessary, suggest adjustments in drainage basic projects and ensure compatibility with sewage and water network projects designed by the local concessionaires. b) Prepare reports and technical assessments on drainage projects. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Drainage projects – Area 1 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 65 days after signing the contract. Product 2 - Drainage projects – Area 2 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 130 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – Drainage projects – Area 3 Description: A consortium will develop drainage projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 195 days after signing the contract. Product 4 – Drainage analysis for degraded areas recovery plan Description: A consortium will design a recovery plan, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 260 days after signing the contract. Product 5 – Drainage analysis for environmental assessment Description: A consortium will design an environmental analysis, and the Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related fields. Work experience:
• At least six (6) years of professional experience in sanitation engineering roles is required, especially related to drainage and sustainable urban drainage design.
• Experience in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable.
• Experience in design and/or work in informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD Civil 3D is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

title: Sanitation Engineer
description:
Result of Service

The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte". UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora", which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review, and, when necessary, suggest adjustments in drainage basic projects and ensure compatibility with sewage and water network projects designed by the local concessionaires. b) Prepare reports and technical assessments on drainage projects. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 - Hydrological studies – Area 1 Description: A consortium will develop hydrological studies, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 65 days after signing the contract. Product 2 - Hydrological studies – Area 2 Description: A consortium will develop hydrological studies, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 130 days after signing the contract. Product 3 - Hydrological studies – Area 3 Description: A consortium will develop hydrological studies, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 195 days after signing the contract. Product 4 – Drainage analysis for box culvert project Description: A consortium will design four (4) box culvert projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 260 days after signing the contract. Product 5 – Technical report review – Area 1, 2, and 3 Description: The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will review technical reports on drainage projects for three (3) areas. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related fields. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of professional experience in sanitation engineering roles is required, especially related to drainage and sustainable urban drainage design.
• Experience in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable.
• Experience in design and/or work in informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD Civil 3D is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You'll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose
Maintain the agreed service levels for IT requests, provide high-value support to customers in accordance with established processes, monitor and report on local IT inventory and incident trends, formalize documentation, and support local activities with a strong focus on onsite assistance, ensuring uninterrupted operations.

Job Description

  • Install, configure, and perform maintenance on PCs, peripherals, and mobile devices
  • Respond to calls via phone, email, and ServiceNow, resolving level 1 incidents
  • Act as smart hands for servers, storage, network, and backup equipment
  • Support office moves and equipment relocation
  • Consult and guide users on hardware and software issues
  • Contribute to demand management and the evolution of applications/infrastructure

  • Monitor local IT inventory and formalize documentation

  • Workplace: Techcenter – Ilha do Fundão

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems or related fields
  • Experience in IT infrastructure and operations
  • Advanced English

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

title: Gerente de Midia
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Olá. Nós somos Haleon.
Uma nova empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor, moldada por todos que se juntam a nós. Juntos, estamos melhorando a saúde cotidiana de bilhões de pessoas. Estamos crescendo e inovando nosso portfólio global de marcas líderes de categoria – incluindo Sal de fruta Eno, Sonrisal, Sensodyne, Advil, Corega e Centrum – através de uma combinação única de compreensão humana profunda e ciência confiável. Somos uma empresa na qual estamos no controle, em um ambiente que estamos co-criando, numa cultura que é única.

Gostaria de se juntar a nós?

Head de Mídia Brasil
Estamos à procura de um Head de Mídia Brasil para Co-liderar com a equipe de Marketing as combinações de marca e mercado atribuídas, com insumos estratégicos, implementação de campanhas, transformação digital e medição de desempenho das campanhas. .

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Implementar os valores agregados atribuídos às principais combinações de marca e mercado provenientes das negociações digitais com fornecedores-chave como Google e Facebook.
  • Conduzir e implementar a agenda de testes e aprendizados conforme os objetivos de mídia definidos no início de cada ano, alinhados à visão global e aos objetivos de negócios do Diretor de Marketing da Latam. Iterar e aprender com essas hipóteses e testes.
  • Co-liderar com o Gerente de Mídia Latam e Head o processo de planejamento de conexões para combinações-chave de marca e mercado.
  • Implementar a estratégia de audiência full funnel e atualizar, otimizar e capturar aprendizados em toda a LATAM.
  • Co-liderar com equipes locais de marketing e atualizar mensalmente os fluxos de mídia local Haleon.
  • Impulsionar inovação em mídia nas marcas atribuídas, garantindo que aproveitemos ao máximo as possibilidades dos fornecedores e as necessidades das marcas (patrocínios, ações especiais na TV), trabalhando de forma transversal com outras áreas como Marketing, Trade, Comex, Analytics e Insights, entre outras.
  • Trabalhar de perto com Insights, Analytics e outras fontes de dados (Brand Lifts, MMMs) para criação de insights a partir da coleta de dados das marcas atribuídas.
  • Criar relatórios trimestrais de desempenho das principais combinações de marca e mercado para apresentar ações que possam melhorar o desempenho das campanhas aos Diretores de Marketing. (Reuniões mensais pós-compra com a agência de mídia devem ser lideradas pelas equipes locais de Marketing, exceto no Brasil, onde o Coordenador de Mídia local fará essa tarefa).

Requisitos:

  • Bacharelado em Marketing, Estatística, Matemática, Economia ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência em marketing ou mídia, preferencialmente em ambiente de bens de consumo ou agência.
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir análises complexas em insights claros e acionáveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para compartilhar insights e recomendações com stakeholders internos.

Se sente que esse é seu próximo passo de carreira, inscreva-se até
21
/11/2025
Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão
Na Haleon, abraçamos nossa força de trabalho diversificada, criando um ambiente inclusivo que celebra nossas perspectivas únicas, gera curiosidade para criar uma compreensão incomparável uns dos outros e promove resultados justos e equitativos para todos.

Estamos nos esforçando para criar um clima onde celebremos nossa diversidade em todas as formas, tratando uns aos outros com respeito, ouvindo diferentes pontos de vista, apoiando nossas comunidades e criando um local de trabalho onde seu eu autêntico pertença e prospere.

Acreditamos em uma cultura de trabalho ágil para todas as nossas funções. Se a flexibilidade for importante para você, recomendamos que explore com nossa equipe de contratação quais são as oportunidades.

Care to join us. Find out what life at Haleon is really like

Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It's important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We'll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account ). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Analista de Faturamento e Cobrança Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

Criado em 1995, o BMA cresceu motivado a encontrar soluções criativas e inovadoras às demandas de nossos clientes nacionais e internacionais. Informações adicionais

Nossa história começa em 1894, com o Club de Regatas Botafogo, e se desdobra em 1904, com o surgimento do Botafogo Football Club. Posteriormente, a fusão entre eles, deu origem ao Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas, 1942. O Clube é reconhecido como o "Glorioso", por seus feitos e conquistas ao longo de toda a sua trajetória no futebol, e conta com uma torcida apaixonada a nível nacional e internacional. Até os dias de hoje, o Alvinegro é o clube que mais cedeu jogadores para a Seleção Brasileira em Copas do Mundo, contribuindo diretamente para três títulos mundiais do Brasil, quando foi base das seleções campeãs em 1958, 1962 e 1970.

O Time da Estrela Solitária é por natureza um verdadeiro celeiro de craques e conta com uma coletânea incomparável de ídolos. Os maiores de todos os tempos vestiram a camisa do Mais Tradicional. Entre suas taças e glórias em campo, o Botafogo é Tricampeão brasileiro e campeão da Libertadores, e segue escrevendo sua história vitoriosa nos gramados.

SAF BOTAFOGO 彡

Liderada por John Textor, a SAF Botafogo assumiu o controle do futebol do Mais Tradicional em março de 2022, sendo pioneira na constituição de um Clube-Empresa no país.

Tendo um projeto ambicioso e profissional como direcionamento, a SAF busca construir um novo Botafogo, forte, vitorioso e inspirador, juntamente com seus verdadeiros donos, os seus torcedores apaixonados.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.
Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.
We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team. 
Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.


Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:

Orchestrate relationships with top-tier suppliers / manufacturers and spearhead cost-effective procurement strategies tailored to the unique demands of our UTOPIA LIVING operations.

In general will be responsible for ordering, administration and supply procurement of the FF&E, OS&E, design and supply within the team.  It will be your responsibility to ensure that the orders are made on time, within budget and in the most efficient manner, ensuring that the Finance Department is kept informed of all necessary compliance.

At a glance:

  • FF&E/Fit Out Budgets and Cost Planning
  • Tendering and Market Research
  • Contracts and Purchase Orders management
  • Payment Forecast and Cost control
  • Logistic, Delivery and Installation plus Handover

  • Assist the FF&E/Interior Designer with sourcing all the information necessary to complete the detailed specification document
  • Work with the design team to build the initial procurement schedule based on the review of layouts, renderings & specifications of the project
  • Responsible for the compilation of the procurement budget and coordinating all documentation ensuring all document standards are met
  • Organize the purchasing schedule, liaising with the Sr. Procurement and Project managers to ensure all project milestones are reached
  • Working closely with the Finance team to raise Funding Requests, produce purchase orders and pay proforma invoices in timely manner
  • Receive, approve and pass invoices for payment and log on procurement schedule
  • Liaise with suppliers across the globe to obtain quotes and discuss terms of service
  • To work within set budgets and timeframes, ensuring items meet the required specification and can be delivered on time
  • Liaise with internal teams and contractors to organize FF&E logistics and installation
  • Quality control
  • Ensure all supplier contacts are up to date
  • Carry out existing supplier reviews & new supplier visits in order to provide a list of approved suppliers to consideration on projects
  • Maintain accurate procurement & budget records & collate information for a weekly procurement review
Requirements
  • Bachelor's Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Supply Chain or Logistic, preferably Master's degree in any of above
  • Project Management degree (Master's or equivalent) is a plus
  • Must have a minimum of 3 years experience within a procurement agency or design studio in a similar role.
  • Advanced/fluent in English and Portquese - required
  • Experience dealing with global projects and suppliers - markets across Europe, Brazil, DR, and Latin America advantageous.
  • Experience in establishing and executing new processes
  • Experience in preparing O&M Manuals for Hospitality projects
Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Assessora ou Assessor Tributário Sênior
description:
Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros. #TaxEY

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

#hibrido

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa assessora tributária Sênior você será parte da área de TAX atuando em ajudar nossos clientes a identificar áreas de riscos, oportunidades de planejamento sustentável ao longo do ciclo de vida dos impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL)  e apoiar no cumprimento de obrigações de conformidade e metas de negócios em todo o mundo, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades: 

  • Atuar como especialista em várias equipes de atendimento ao cliente, participando de projetos na área de Business Tax Advisory (BTA) ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações. Prestar consultoria na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos Imposto de Renda de Pessoas Jurídicas (IRPJ) e Contribuição Social sobre o Lucro Líquido (CSLL);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos/às supervisores/as a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo/a ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua: 

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – Lucro real e lucro presumindo;
  • Habilidades avançadas de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Dedicação ao trabalho em equipe e à liderança.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos: 

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.
  • Conhecimento nos principais benefícios fiscais brasileiros como Lei do Bem, Rota 2030, Lucro da exploração, entre outros;

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão. 

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work  2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor

title: Pessoa Captadora de Recursos
description:
Descrição e Responsabilidades:
Horário: De segunda à sexta, 06h/dia 30horas semanas
Nível: Profissional
Regime de contratação: Efetivo – CLT

Descrição e Responsabilidades

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Em MSF, não toleramos qualquer forma de abuso ou comportamento inadequado, seja em relação a colegas de trabalho, pacientes, doadores ou qualquer outra parte envolvida nas nossas operações.

Além disso, buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans, PcD e pessoas com mais de 40 anos.

CONTEXTO DA VAGA:

A captação de novas pessoas doadoras para a organização é o principal recurso para que possamos atuar nos mais diversos contextos de ajuda médica humanitária ao redor do mundo. Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa.

COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL:

Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras.

Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana, abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo.

É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa.

Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você

COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

  • Captar novas pessoas doadoras mensais nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro (trabalho 100% externo), apresentando uma abordagem objetiva e segura, a fim de garantir o ingresso de recursos para MSF;
  • Preservar a imagem de MSF, mantendo uma postura profissional em meio a situações desconfortantes, com intuito de demonstrar segurança e responsabilidade na atuação;
  • Assegurar o cadastro correto das novas pessoas doadoras, preenchendo com atenção e precisão os dados, para garantir o correto ingresso no sistema;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as questões que envolvem a Organização, buscando sempre informação junto aos gestores, assim como nas redes sociais, para maior esclarecimento na captação de novas pessoas doadores.

Requisitos:

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Português fluente;
  • Ensino médio completo ou cursando graduação;
  • Pacote Office básico.

O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?

  • Experiências com vendas, captação de recursos, telemarketing, atendimento ao público, terceiro setor.

QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

  • Gerenciamento de estresse pois controla reações ultra emotivas e responde com calma;
  • Capacidade de negociação para comunicar aos outros os seus próprios objetivos e demandas;
  • Iniciativa e inovação para identificar oportunidades e problemas;
  • Flexibilidade comportamental para adaptar comportamentos as necessidades da situação.

Venha fazer parte da Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno.

title: Fisiologista do Futebol Feminino
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de Contabilidade Pleno para trilhar um caminho glorioso com o Botafogo 彡

Este cargo tem como objetivo atuar diretamente no monitoramento, análise e interpretação de dados físicos e fisiológicos, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão técnica, o planejamento do treinamento e os processos de prevenção, recuperação e retorno ao treino/jogo, sempre em integração com a comissão técnica e o staff multidisciplinar.

E aí, curtiu? Venha jogar junto em nosso time

SAFBotafogo #ÉDiferente


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o monitoramento fisiológico, físico e de carga interna e externa das atletas durante treinos e jogos;
  • Operar e analisar dados provenientes de sistemas de GPS, com ênfase em Catapult, garantindo qualidade, consistência e interpretação adequada das informações;
  • Planejar, executar e interpretar avaliações físicas e fisiológicas, utilizando os equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance, de acordo com os protocolos do NSP;
  • Atuar no controle, organização, análise e visualização de dados, com produção de relatórios claros e objetivos para suporte à tomada de decisão da comissão técnica e coordenação;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de termografia aplicada ao esporte como suporte ao monitoramento, prevenção de lesões e acompanhamento de processos de recuperação, respeitando critérios técnicos e clínicos;
  • Integrar-se de forma contínua com as áreas de preparação física, fisioterapia e medicina, contribuindo para processos de prevenção, recuperação, retorno ao treino e retorno ao jogo (RTP);
  • Apoiar o planejamento do treinamento a partir da análise dos dados fisiológicos, das avaliações e do contexto competitivo;
  • Garantir a padronização de processos, registros e fluxos de informação do Núcleo de Saúde e Performance.

Requisitos e qualificações

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

  • Graduação em Educação Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de sistemas de GPS aplicados ao futebol, com ênfase em Catapult;
  • Experiência no uso de equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance (ex.: força, potência, assimetrias e controle neuromuscular);
  • Conhecimento em termografia aplicada ao esporte.
  • Capacidade de análise, tratamento e visualização de dados, utilizando ferramentas como:
  • Excel (nível intermediário a avançado)
  • Power BI ou ferramentas similares de visualização de dados
  • Familiaridade com softwares e plataformas de monitoramento e controle de carga;

Você se destaca, se tiver:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Fisiologia do Exercício, Ciências do Esporte, Treinamento Esportivo ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência prévia como fisiologista ou função correlata em futebol, preferencialmente em ambientes de alto rendimento;
  • Vivência comprovada com monitoramento de carga por GPS, especialmente com Catapult;
  • Experiência prática com equipamentos de avaliação da VALD Performance (ex.: força, assimetrias, potência, controle neuromuscular);
  • Conhecimento e experiência no uso de termografia aplicada ao esporte;
  • Capacidade de análise, tratamento, controle e visualização de dados, com domínio de ferramentas digitais e elaboração de relatórios.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com o futebol feminino, compreendendo suas particularidades fisiológicas, incluindo:
  • Influência do ciclo menstrual no desempenho, carga e recuperação
  • Diferenças de resposta à carga, fadiga e risco de lesão
  • Aspectos específicos de prevenção e monitoramento em atletas mulheres
  • Experiência em trabalho integrado com equipes multidisciplinares, com boa comunicação e alinhamento institucional.
  • Cursos em Fisiologia do Exercício aplicada ao Futebol;
  • Cursos ou formações específicas em monitoramento de carga, GPS e análise de desempenho;
  • Capacitação no uso de Catapult e/ou VALD Performance;
  • Certificações ou formações complementares em termografia esportiva.

Informações adicionais

Nossa história começa em 1894, com o Club de Regatas Botafogo, e se desdobra em 1904, com o surgimento do Botafogo Football Club. Posteriormente, a fusão entre eles, deu origem ao Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas, 1942. O Clube é reconhecido como o "Glorioso", por seus feitos e conquistas ao longo de toda a sua trajetória no futebol, e conta com uma torcida apaixonada a nível nacional e internacional. Até os dias de hoje, o Alvinegro é o clube que mais cedeu jogadores para a Seleção Brasileira em Copas do Mundo, contribuindo diretamente para três títulos mundiais do Brasil, quando foi base das seleções campeãs em 1958, 1962 e 1970.

O Time da Estrela Solitária é por natureza um verdadeiro celeiro de craques e conta com uma coletânea incomparável de ídolos. Os maiores de todos os tempos vestiram a camisa do Mais Tradicional. Entre suas taças e glórias em campo, o Botafogo é Tricampeão brasileiro e campeão da Libertadores, e segue escrevendo sua história vitoriosa nos gramados.

SAF BOTAFOGO 彡

Liderada por John Textor, a SAF Botafogo assumiu o controle do futebol do Mais Tradicional em março de 2022, sendo pioneira na constituição de um Clube-Empresa no país.

Tendo um projeto ambicioso e profissional como direcionamento, a SAF busca construir um novo Botafogo, forte, vitorioso e inspirador, juntamente com seus verdadeiros donos, os seus torcedores apaixonados.

title: Tax Jr Analyst
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE


We are looking for a Tax Jr Analyst to support our Tax Team with Brazilian tax demands. This role is a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to deepen their experience in tax compliance within a dynamic, global, and technology-driven environment. You will work closely with accounting, finance, and external partners to ensure our tax processes in Brazil run smoothly and in full compliance with legislation.

ABOUT THE TEAM


Our VTEX Tax Team manages every aspect related to tax planning and compliance, focusing on accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement of our global tax operations. In Brazil, the team plays a critical role in ensuring compliance with local requirements while collaborating with other regions to maintain alignment with global standards.As part of this team, you will:

  • Manage tax and accounting activities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax regulations;
  • Review and calculate Direct and Indirect Tax and returns;
  • Register and reconcile journal entries related to tax accounts (recoverable, payable, and expense accounts);
  • Keep the accounting reconciliations for tax accounts updated and accurate;
  • Support the implementation and improvement of SOX controls;
  • Stay up to date with changes in Brazilian tax legislation, sharing key updates with the team;
  • Help clarify withholding tax questions from internal stakeholders;
  • Prepare documentation for tax audits and inspections;
  • Collaborate with local and global teams to ensure alignment between tax, accounting, and finance processes.
WHO YOU ARE
  • You are based in Rio de Janeiro and willing to go to the office 1–2x a week;
  • You have a Bachelor's degree (completed) in Accounting, Business Administration, Law, Economics, or related areas;
  • You have 3–5 years of experience in Tax or Accounting, ideally in a corporate environment or consulting firm;
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian tax legislation;
  • Knowledge of journal entries and reconciliation of tax accounts (assets, liabilities, and P&L);
  • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is a plus;
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
  • Advanced user of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets;
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset;
  • Intermediate English — comfortable reading documentation and communicating with global peers when necessary.

About VTEX


VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2.4 thousand global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3.4 thousand active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, For more information, visit

If you want to add this: We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia.

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.
